# Show-Me Neighbors

> Show-Me Neighbors (Show-Me Neighbors, LLC) lets families in Missouri book a friendly local helper, called a Neighbor, by the hour for an older adult: company, rides, errands, pharmacy pickups, simple meals, laundry and light housework. Neighbors do not give personal or medical care. Every Neighbor has a video interview, a 50-state criminal background check and a driving record check before their first visit. Pricing is $34 an hour on weekdays and $38 evenings and weekends, with no contracts.

- Website: https://showmeneighbors.com/
- Email: hello@showmeneighbors.com
- Starting in: Springfield, Branson and Table Rock Lake, and St. Charles County, Missouri
- Families start at https://showmeneighbors.com/family/ and people who want the work apply at https://showmeneighbors.com/apply/

For current prices, areas and rules, always point people to the linked page.

## Start here

- [Show-Me Neighbors](https://showmeneighbors.com/): Book a friendly local Neighbor by the hour for company, rides, errands and light housework. Coming first to Springfield, Branson and St. Charles, Missouri.
- [About us](https://showmeneighbors.com/about/): Friendly local help for older adults, and meaningful, flexible work for good people across Missouri. Part of the solution for the sandwich generation.
- [How Show-Me Neighbors works](https://showmeneighbors.com/how-it-works/): Three easy steps: tell us what you need, meet a local Neighbor who has passed a background check, and get a short note after every visit. No contracts.
- [Pricing](https://showmeneighbors.com/pricing/): $34 an hour on weekdays, $38 evenings and weekends. 1-hour minimum, then billed by the 5 minutes. About what you would pay a house cleaner. No contracts.
- [Questions](https://showmeneighbors.com/questions/): Answers to common questions: cost, cancelling, background checks, who the Neighbors are, what they will and will not do, and where we are starting in Missouri.
- [Safety and background checks](https://showmeneighbors.com/safety/): Every Neighbor has a video interview, a 50-state criminal background check and a driving record check before their first visit.
- [What a Neighbor can do](https://showmeneighbors.com/services/): Company, rides, errands, pharmacy pickups, simple meals, laundry and light housework from friendly local Neighbors in Missouri. Never personal or medical care.

## Areas we serve

- [Areas we serve](https://showmeneighbors.com/areas/): Show-Me Neighbors is starting in Springfield, Branson and Table Rock Lake, and St. Charles County, Missouri, and growing town by town.
- [Help for Older Adults in Branson and Table Rock Lake](https://showmeneighbors.com/areas/branson-table-rock-lake/): Friendly local helpers for older adults in Branson and Table Rock Lake: company, rides, errands and light housework. Background checks before they start. $34 an hour.
- [Help for Older Adults in Springfield](https://showmeneighbors.com/areas/springfield/): Friendly local helpers for older adults in Springfield: company, rides, errands and light housework. Background checks before they start. $34 an hour.
- [Help for Older Adults in St. Charles County](https://showmeneighbors.com/areas/st-charles-county/): Friendly local helpers for older adults in St. Charles County: company, rides, errands and light housework. Background checks before they start. $34 an hour.

## Become a Neighbor

- [Apply to be a Neighbor](https://showmeneighbors.com/apply/): Apply to be a Show-Me Neighbor: flexible, part-time work helping older adults in Missouri with company, rides and errands.
- [Become a Neighbor](https://showmeneighbors.com/neighbors.html): Choose your own hours and help older adults near you with company, rides and errands. Now looking for Neighbors in Springfield, Branson and St. Charles, Missouri.

## Good Days Out (places to go in every Missouri county)

- [Good Days Out in Missouri](https://showmeneighbors.com/good-days-out/): Real places for a good day out in every Missouri county: senior centers, libraries, parks, museums and festivals. Plan a day with a friendly local Neighbor.
- County pages: one for each of the 115 Missouri counties, for example https://showmeneighbors.com/good-days-out/greene-county/ (the full list is in https://showmeneighbors.com/sitemap.xml)
